title: May Administration Portal — Data Contract
appliesTo: May Administration Portal (CMA Part 1 Exam Simulator Admin Interface)

preamble.purpose: Define the complete data contract for all admin-facing views in the May Administration Portal. This contract specifies what data each role can see, how it is fetched, what operations are permitted, and how views relate to each other. It is a design document — no implementation code.
preamble.scope: Five admin views covering student management, content investigation, content administration, governance oversight, and system administration. All views operate on the project's existing data artifacts (pack files, registries, pipeline outputs, governance records).

roles.name: Support Staff / Instructor
roles.description: Views student progress and session history. Cannot modify content.

roles.name: Governance Board / Release Manager
roles.description: Monitors compliance, manages certification pipeline, oversees risk.

roles.name: Platform Operator
roles.description: Full system access. Monitors health, data integrity, file state.

apiPatterns.format: All responses in JSON. All timestamps in ISO 8601. All IDs in their canonical formats.

authorization.enforcement: Per-endpoint role check. Return 403 Forbidden if role insufficient.

ON_DEMAND.note: Initiated by System Admin or Governance role. May be long-running (>30s for full-pool scans).

dependencies.impactIfBroken: Student exposure data may show questions that were blocked/removed
Investigation links may break if QIDs are reindexed or registries become stale
Content writes may corrupt pack files if integrity not verified first
Release authorization may proceed with stale or incorrect safety data
System integrity checks may produce false drift alerts

crossViewDataDependencies.criticalPath: View5 → View4 → View3 → View2 → View1 (bottom-up dependency chain: file integrity must be confirmed before content admin writes, governance must verify before release, investigations depend on content admin data, student view depends on all upstream data)

breakingChanges: Removing or renaming any endpoint path
Removing or renaming any required field in a response
Changing a field type (e.g., string → integer)
Removing an enumeration value from a closed enum
Adding a new required field to a request body
Changing authentication method or token format
nonBreakingChanges: Adding new optional fields to responses
Adding new query parameters with defaults
Adding new enumeration values to open enums
Adding new roles or permission profiles

deprecationPolicy.documentation: All deprecated endpoints remain in contract with deprecation notice for full notice period

contractUpdateProcess: Propose change in a session-spec artifact (SESSION-NNN_*)
Review against all 5 view schemas for cross-view impact
Update contract version per semantic versioning
Run full governance guard test suite (must be ALL PASS)
Deploy with new contract version number

guardRulesEnforced.adminPortalEnforcement: Any PATCH to ExplanationWrong fields must pass Rule 2 validation before write commits
Registry regeneration only via POST endpoint, never direct edit

guardRulesEnforced.description: Max 30 question objects per change-set without BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker
guardRulesEnforced.adminPortalEnforcement: Remediation batch creation enforces ≤30 QIDs. BLOCK-AUTHORIZED override requires governance role.

guardRulesEnforced.description: No empty non-CC ExplanationWrong slots (DL-026/DL-035 prevention) — deployed S814
guardRulesEnforced.adminPortalEnforcement: Certification execution checks all non-CC EW slots are non-empty before certifying

rules: G-NEW-1: Metadata-block ChoiceA-D must match content-block Choices.A-D (DL-016 prevention)
G-NEW-2: ExplanationWrong text must be topically relevant to the learner-facing distractor
G-NEW-3: CorrectChoice extraction must use within-object parsing, not forward-scan (DL-029 prevention)
G-NEW-4: Case-study item explanations must meet sufficiency standards

backupProtocol.portalEnforcement: Content write endpoints must confirm backup exists before committing write. Timestamped backup path returned in response.
